title: State highway fund to defray expenses of motor vehicle safety office.
bodyText: The department of transportation may expend funds from the state highway fund to defray the cost of administration and operation of the motor vehicle safety office.
bodyHtml: [§248-12]  State highway fund to defray expenses of motor vehicle safety office.  The department of transportation may expend funds from the state highway fund to defray the cost of administration and operation of the motor vehicle safety office. [L 1978, c 159, §6]
